entries.subject: Cassini ISS archive and PDS shape release
entries.finding: The [Cassini ISS calibrated archive](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/) supplies the observation lens and the [PDS shape release](https://sbn.psi.edu/pds/resource/saturnsatshapes.html) supplies geometry and radial-height visualization.

entries.subject: Voyager-era Stooke and Celestia maps
entries.finding: The Voyager-era Stooke shaded-relief and Celestia maps represent a different, older cartographic interpretation and cannot be described as Cassini observed pixels; the original Western University distribution URL currently returns 404. They add no qualified improvement over the chosen Cassini frames.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered observational map improves on the Cassini frames.

entries.subject: SBIB Cassini catalog as a download path
entries.finding: [SBIB’s Cassini catalog](https://sbn.psi.edu/pds/sbib/saturn.html) currently omits Pandora from its listed targets. This is a limitation of that catalog, not a claim that other Pandora datasets do not exist.

entries.subject: Cassini ISS frame N1860792100_1 in the Monochrome lens
entries.finding: Its published camera places 99.9% of the lit source shape on the photograph's sky while the body lies elsewhere in the frame, so preparation refuses it; no camera correction is invented.
entries.revisitWhen: A corrected camera or pointing solution for the frame registers it with interior holdouts.

entries.subject: Additional IR3/GRN/UV3 sequence near 249 degrees west
entries.finding: N1504612418_1, N1504612452_1 and N1504612385_1 were acquired and trialed. A color-coverage trial expanded area from 17.1% to 40.7%, but the fitted IR3 band failed the independent maximum-residual criterion: 2.519 pixels against a 2-pixel limit (RMS 0.796 pixels). This unqualified trial is not shipped. Other published sequences remain possible future candidates.
entries.revisitWhen: A controlled fit passes the independent criteria without relaxing them, or a different sequence supplies independently verified coverage.
